comparison_priorities: Dated strength-to-running handover and a recovery week must be visible in native output.

More regular marathon-specific rehearsal should occur before the taper when fitness and recovery support it, with realistic fuel practice.
Maintenance loading should remain effort-led rather than frozen indefinitely to initial suggested kilograms.

Do not report a sub3 finish as guaranteed merely from prior race time.

profiles.title: First powerlifting meet

artifact_assumptions.lifting_familiarity: Assumes athlete already knows the lifts; not a supplied training-age history
artifact_assumptions.availability: M/W/F strength, Tue/Sat easy running, Thu/Sun rest. Athlete availability and minute caps not supplied.
artifact_assumptions.running_baseline: No confirmed recent mileage or race baseline; health runs prescribe distance-or-time, whichever comes first
artifact_assumptions.rep_set_effort: User did not state baseline-set RPE

coaching_baseline.speed_bench_start_repetition: 50kg appears across almost all 25 pre-meet weeks, with no explicit rebaseline instruction
coaching_baseline.commands: General depth/pause/lockout reminders; week23 asks for command-practice singles
coaching_baseline.progression: After two comparable top sets at least1RPE below target, consider small increases; otherwise repeat or effort-adjust
coaching_baseline.backoff_load: 90-93% of actual top set; effort priority over percentage not made explicit

comparison_priorities: Preserve rep baselines and avoid a mandatory max test or fabricated rep-set RPE.
Volume, strength and speed must have distinct purposes and doses with progressing/reviewed speed reference loads.
Make effort the explicit governing target if suggested percentage and RPE conflict.
Test purposeful variation and return to competition specificity, with actually prescribed command practice.
Compare sensible novice effort progression and final exposures; RPE9 need not be forced on an inexperienced athlete.
Health running should remain appropriate to unknown baseline rather than inventing race pace or mileage.
